{{Modifier info
| title = Bonus Card
| image = Bonus Card.png
| type = Enhancement
| effect = {{hl|blue|+30}} extra chips
}}
'''Bonus Cards''' are playing cards that are [[Enhanced]] to give {{Chips|+30}} to a played hand when scored.

*{{Tarot|The Hierophant}} can make up to 2 cards in your hand Bonus Cards.
*{{spectral|Incantation}}, {{spectral|Familiar}}, and {{spectral|Grim}} can add Bonus {{n|Number}}, {{f|Face}}, and {{a|Ace}} cards, respectively.
*[[Booster Packs|Standard Packs]] can contain Bonus Cards.
*{{V|Illusion}} allows for Bonus cards to be purchased in [[The Shop]].

== Usage notes ==
* Between [[Jokers]] that give {{Mult|}} and {{Chips|}}, ones that give {{Chips|}} are far fewer in number, making {{Tarot|The Hierophant}} a good option in a pinch.
* Retriggering with a {{Seal|Red|image=Bonus Card.png}} or the Common {{J|Hanging Chad}} can make it particularly strong in {{D|Plasma}}, but also in all decks' early to mid game.

==Synergies==
===[[Decks]]===
* Chips are at their absolute strongest on {{D|Plasma}} due to the balancing gimmick, making Bonus cards a worthwhile investment.
===[[Poker Hands]]===
All poker hands work with Bonus cards, as they provide Chips for the player's base score. However, during the early game, poker hands with low base Chips like {{ph|High Card}} and {{ph|Pair}} tend to benefit the most from Bonus Cards. Conversely, larger hands like {{ph|Flushes}} and {{ph|Straights}} allow more Bonus cards to be played, increasing the player's score even more.
